The generated tier catches up with the API's multi-entity step: a graph is
one reporting group, and every ledger operation can name which entity of it
to act on. Nothing on the stable tier changes shape; the one generated-tier
removal is named below.

## New: entities in a reporting group

`createEntity` (`POST /extensions/roboledger/{graph_id}/operations/create-entity`)
with `CreateEntityRequest`, `CreateEntityData`, `CreateEntityResponses` and
`CreateEntityErrors` adds a subsidiary to the graph's group: a name, its
legal form, the share the parent holds (`ownership_pct`), an optional
`parent_entity_id` to nest it under another subsidiary, and an optional
`ticker`, which prefixes the entity's account names and must be unique in
the graph (409). `LedgerEntityResponse` gains `ownership_pct`.

`entity_id` is a new optional field on `UpdateEntityRequest`,
`InitializeLedgerRequest`, `SetCloseTargetOperation`, `ClosePeriodOperation`,
`ReopenPeriodOperation`, `BackfillPlanHistoryOperation`,
`InitializeChartOfAccountsRequest`, `CreateReportRequest`,
`LinkEntityTaxonomyRequest`, `CreateEventBlockRequest` and
`LiveFinancialStatementRequest`. Omitted, each acts on the group parent, so
every existing call behaves as before. `FiscalCalendarResponse` and
`ReportResponse` carry `entity_id`.

`LiveFinancialStatementRequest.consolidated` renders the group's combined
statement on the parent — every entity under the parent's Reporting Style,
summed per concept, with nothing eliminated between them — and
`LiveFinancialStatementResponse` carries `entity_id`, `consolidated` and
`combined_entity_ids`.

## Removed: `selectGraph`

`selectGraph` and its `SelectGraphData`, `SelectGraphResponses`,
`SelectGraphErrors`, `SelectGraphResponse` and `SelectGraphError` types are
gone from `/sdk`. The API deprecated the graph-scoped select in favour of
`setSelectedGraph` — the replacement 2.7.0 shipped — and has now removed the
endpoint, so the generated function would only ever have met a 404. No
facade wrapped it; `setSelectedGraph` is the call.
